text:
maya: FYI customer Acme reported a 3x spike on their Nov invoice — they believe we double-counted ~2 hours worth of embeddings during a transient ingestion retry window (2024-11-15 14:03–14:17 UTC). Can someone confirm meter and propose an adjustment?
liam: can you paste the query you used to estimate double-count? need to know if it's embedding tokens vs textgen and whether retries were deduped upstream.
maya: quick repro query I ran to spot duplicate request_ids (shows attempts and embed counts):
```sql
select request_id, count(*) as attempts, sum(embedding_count) as embeds, min(ts) as first_ts
from meter.events
where customer_id = 'acme' and ts between '2024-11-15 14:00' and '2024-11-15 15:00'
group by request_id
having count(*) > 1
order by attempts desc
limit 50;
```
returns ~187 request_ids with attempts>1; aggregated extra embed tokens ~1.2M. not sure which of these were actually billed.
greta: ops checked infra logs — edge-proxy had a reconnect loop 14:03–14:17 UTC. many clients retried, and because requests landed on different shards the upstream dedupe never hit in some cases. we saw identical request_id header for ~62% of retries.
liam: that fits. i'll join the deduped ids against billing to see what was invoiced. running a billing join like:
```sql
select sum(b.charge_amount) as billed_dup, count(distinct e.request_id) as duplicate_count
from billing.ledger b
join (select request_id, sum(embedding_count) as embeds from meter.events where ts between '2024-11-15 14:00' and '2024-11-15 15:00' group by request_id having count(*)>1) e
on b.request_id = e.request_id
where b.customer_id = 'acme';
```
will post numbers in a few mins.
finance-bot: Invoice 2024-11-15-ACME flagged: duplicate_request_ratio=0.062 > threshold 0.05; manual review requested.
jordan: for approvals we need: proposed credit amount, GL code, and communication draft. if it's < $5k desk credit ok; else needs finance ops approval.
liam: join result: billed amount for duplicated request_ids = $3,820. compute cost estimate for the extra tokens ~ $420. proposing full customer credit $3,820 and internal chargeback to infra for $420. I'll create Jira BILL-4123, attach CSV of request_ids + counts + ledger rows.
sarah: approved: issue customer credit $3,820. internal chargeback to infra accepted. @jordan please process invoice adjustment and send updated statement. offer 1M free embed tokens as goodwill and include one-sentence apology/explain.
jordan: noted. I'll file the adjustment today, GL code 6420, payment_reason 'metering-dup-retry-20241115', and loop in CS for the customer note. will attach the draft message before sending.
maya: thanks — follow-ups: greta to write short postmortem on edge retry and mitigation; liam to attach CSV to Jira and mark which were billed; jordan to complete adjustment and close the customer loop. 
:thumbsup:
